# Damaged Helmet

`DamagedHelmet.glb` is the Khronos glTF sample model "Damaged Helmet",
unmodified, from
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/DamagedHelmet
(downloaded 2026-11-27).
